verdict.rationale: Moneybird documents a first-party MCP channel so users can operate the product through natural-language chat in Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or any MCP client. The language understanding itself comes from that external client, not from Moneybird, and the evidence is only brief llms.txt mentions with no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language interface, documentation of which operations the MCP exposes, and independent or hands-on verification that natural-language commands work end to end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Three channels on the same REST API: MCP for an AI chat, the CLI for the terminal, the API for your own software.
